title: Package Left on Porch Too Long
dataSources: Pet tracker location/activity (`tractive:position`, `whistle:activity`), smart feeder events (`petfeeder:event`), litter-box usage (`litterrobot:cycle`), bird-feeder detections (`birdfeeder:detection`), doorbell/package events (`doorbell:event`).
app: Pet GPS/activity trackers (Tractive/Fi/Whistle), smart feeders and litter boxes, bird feeders/cams, and home-life sensors via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=doorbell:event
| stats earliest(_time) as arrival, latest(pickup_time) as pickup_time by package_id
| eval minutes_on_porch=round((pickup_time-arrival)/60,1)
| where minutes_on_porch>60
| sort - minutes_on_porch
description: Measures how long delivered packages remained outside, useful for both theft risk and catching grocery drops that sat longer than intended.
value: A package duration metric turns the doorbell from a reactive notification stream into a real household logistics monitor.
implementation: Forward package-arrival and pickup timestamps from your doorbell workflow; alert on long porch dwell time for important deliveries.
visualization: Table of packages by time spent on the porch.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks when a delivered package sat outside for a long time before anyone brought it in.
